title: UBUSHINJACYAHA v. SIBOMANA ALIAS
text:
UBUSHINJACYAHA v. SIBOMANA ALIAS
[Rwanda URUKIKO RW’UBUJURIRE – RPAA00125/2025/CA (Kanyange, J. P.) 19 Ukuboza 2025]
Amategeko agenga imiburanishirize y’imanza nshinjabyaha – Ubujurire – Impamvu z’ubujurire –
Impamvu itaraburanyweho mu rubanza rujuririrwa ntiyasuzumwa ku rwego rw’ubujurire, kuko itafatwa
nk’inenge iri mu rubanza cyangwa ikosa ryakozwe n’urukiko rubanza ku buryo byashingirwaho biba
impamvu y’ubujurire.
Amategeko agenga imiburanishirize y’imanza nshinjabyaha – Ubujurire – Impamvu z’ubujurire –
Iyakirwa z’impamvu z’ubujurire – Ingingo iyo ariyo yose itanzwe nyuma y’ibihe ntarengwa byo kujurira,
uretse iyuzuza cyangwa isobanura iyatanzwe mu bihe byemewe byo kujurira, ntigomba kwakirwa.
Incamake y’ikibazo: Sibomana Alias yaketsweho gusambanya umwana w’umukobwa w’imyaka 7,
arafatwa atangira gukurikiranwa, ageze mu nzego z’iperereza yemera icyaha, maze Ubushinjacyaha
bumurega mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Muhanga, bumusabira igifungo cya burundu. Mu Rukiko Uregwa
nabwo yaburanye yemera icyaha, avuga ko yasambanyije uwo mwana ababyeyi be badahari ariko ko mu
kumusambanya atinjije cyane igitsina.
Urukiko Rwisumbuye rushingiye ku bimenyetso bitandukanye birimo imvugo y’Uregwa yo kwemera
icyaha, rwaciye urubanza rwemeza ko ahamwa n’icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana, rumuhanisha igifungo
cya burundu. Icyo cyemezo Uregwa yakijuririye mu Rukiko Rukuru asaba kugabanyirizwa igihano, ngo
kuko yahanishijwe igihano kiremereye kandi yaremeye icyaha kuva mu nzego z’iperereza no mu Rukiko
no kuba ari ubwa mbere akurikiranweho icyaha. Ubushinjacyaha bwasubije kuri izo mpamvu z’ubujurire
bw’Uregwa buvuga ko yagabanyirizwa ariko igihano ntikije munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka 25 kuko kubera
ubugome yakoranye icyaha asambanya umwana muto.
Urukiko Rukuru rushingiye ku mpamvu nyoroshyacyaha zatanzwe n’Uregwa rwamugabanyirije igihano,
rumuhanisha igifungo cy’imyaka 21, n’ubwo yongeye kujurira muri uru Rukiko rw’Ubujurire avuga ko
yahamijwe icyaha atakoze kuko nta raporo yagaragaje ko yasambanyijwe, ko kandi byakozwe nawe, ariko
mu mwanzuro w’inyongera asaba ko yagabanyirizwa igihano mu gihe uru Rukiko rubibonye ukundi.
Muri uru rubanza, Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko Uregwa ntacyo anenga imikirize y’urubanza yajuririye,
usibye guhakana icyaha yakoze ageze muri ubu bujurire bwa kabiri, kandi kuva ku rwego rwa mbere no
mu bujurire bwa mbere akomeza kucyemera, ndetse bishingirwaho agabanyirizwa igihano, ko rero uko
kugihakana ntacyo byamumarira. Buvuga kandi ko impamvu yo kuba yagabanyirizwa igihano Uregwa
yatanze mu mwanzuro w’inyongera itakwakirwa kuko yatanzwe impitagihe, bityo ko uru Rukiko
rwakwemeza ko ubujurire bwe nta shingiro bufite.
Incamake y’icyemezo: 1. Impamvu itaraburanyweho mu rubanza rujuririrwa ntiyasuzumwa ku rwego
rw’ubujurire, kuko itafatwa nk’inenge iri mu rubanza cyangwa ikosa ryakozwe n’urukiko rubanza ku
buryo byashingirwaho biba impamvu y’ubujurire.
2. Ingingo iyo ariyo yose itanzwe nyuma y’ibihe ntarengwa byo kujurira, uretse iyuzuza cyangwa
isobanura iyatanzwe mu bihe byemewe byo kujurira, ntigomba kwakirwa.
Ubujurire nta shingiro bufite.
Amategeko yashingiweho:
Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya
ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, ingingo ya 2.

Itegeko Nº68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange nk’uko ryahinduwe,
ingingo ya 49, 59 n’iya 133.
Imanza zashingiweho:
RCOMAA00071/2017/CS, Mbuto Aimable v. BRD, rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga ku wa 26/10/2018.
RPAA00888/2024/CA, Ubushinjacyaha v. Uwamahoro Claire, rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa
27/05/2025.
RPAA00024/2021/CA, Ubushinjacyaha v. Mukayisenga, rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa
29/07/2022.
Urubanza
I. IMITERERE Y’URUBANZA
[1] Sibomana Aimable yaketsweho gusambanya umwana w’imyaka 7 wahawe izina rya T.I muri uru
rubanza1, biturutse ku kuba nyirakuru w’uwo mwana yaravuze ko ku wa 07/02/2021 yamusize mu rugo,
agarutse asanga ku marembo hafungiye imbere abura umukingurira ariko nyuma uwo mwuzukuru we aza
kumukingurira, asanga Sibomana ari mu rugo, amubaza icyo yakoraga yikingiranye n’umwana amubwira
ko ntacyo yakoraga, ariko abajije uwo mwana amubwira ko barongoranye, ahita ahuruza abantu
baramufata bamujyana ku Murenge, atangira gukurikiranwa.
[2] Nyuma y’iperereza, Ubushinjacyaha bwareze Sibomana Aimable mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa
Muhanga icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana, bushingiye ku kuba Sibomana Aimable yaremmeye icyaha
mu nzego z’iperereza, ku mvugo za T.I, iz’abatangabuhamya hamwe n’icyemezo cy’amavuko kigaragaza
ko T.I yari afite imyaka 7, bumusabira igifungo cya burundu.
[3] Sibomana Aimable yaburanye yemera icyaha, avuga ko yasambanyije T.I. ababyeyi be badahari
ariko ko mu kumusambanya atinjije cyane igitsina.
[4] Urukiko rwaciye urubanza RP00216/2021/TGI/MHG ku wa 24/02/2021, rusanga hari ibimenyetso
bihamya ko Sibomana Aimable yakoze icyaha akurikiranweho bigizwe no kuba acyemera, ukwo kwemera
kugashimangirwa n’imvugo za nyirakuru wa T.I. wavuze ko yageze mu rugo akamusangana n’uwo
mwana bakinze, uwo mwana akamubwira ko yamusambanyije. Rwasanze kandi n’ubwo yorohereje
ubutabera akemera icyaha, atagabanyirizwa igihano kuko yasambanyije umwana muto, rumuhanisha
igifungo cya burundu.
[5] Sibomana Aimable yajuriye mu Rukiko Rukuru/Urugereko rwa Nyanza, avuga ko yahanishijwe
igihano kiremereye kandi yaremeye icyaha kuva mu nzego z’iperereza no mu Rukiko no kuba ari ubwa
mbere akurikiranweho icyaha, asaba ko igihano yahanishijwe cyagabanywa.
[6] Ubushinjacyaha bwasubije ko hashingirwa ku kwemera icyaha kwa Sibomana Aimable
akagabanyirizwa igihano ariko ntikijye munsi y’imyaka 25, kubera ubugome yakoranye icyaha
asambanya umwana muto.
[7] Urukiko rwaciye urubanza RPA00324/2021/HC/NYZ ku wa 13/01/2025, rusanga kuba Sibomana
Aimable yaraburanye yemera icyaha kandi akaba ari ubwa mbere akoze icyaha mu buryo buzwi,
byamubera impamvu nyoroshyacyaha zatuma agabanyirizwa igihano, rumuhanisha igifungo cy’imyaka
21.
1 Kubera ko ari umwana.

[8] Sibomana Aimable yongeye ajurira mu Rukiko rw’Ubujurire, urubanza rwandikwa kuri
RPAA00125/2025/CA, iburanisha ribera mu ruhame ku wa 04/12/2025 yunganirwa na Me Shema
T.Gerald, Ubushinjacyaha buhagarariwe na Rukaka Gallican, Umushinjacyaha ku rwego rw’Igihugu.
[9] Mu myanzuro y’ubujurire no mu miburanire, Sibomana Aimable n’umwunganira bavuga ko
yahamijwe icyaha atakoze cyo gusambanya umwana, kuko nta raporo ya muganga yagaragaje ko
yasambanyijwe ko kandi byakozwe na Sibomana, naho mu mwanzuro w’inyongera, umwunganira avuga
ko mu gihe Urukiko rwabibona ukundi rwamugabanyiriza igihano.
[10] Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga ko Urukiko rwakwemeza ko ubujurire bwa Sibomana
Aimable nta shingiro bufite, kuko nta nenge agaragaza iri mu rubanza ajuririra, naho impamvu yo
kugabanyirizwa igihano ikaba itasuzumwa kuko yatanzwe impitagihe.
[11] Ibibazo bigomba gusuzumwa muri uru rubanza, ni ukumenya niba impamvu Sibomana
ataburanishije mu rubanza rujuririrwa yasuzumwa nk’inenge iri muri urwo rubanza, no kumenya niba
impamvu yo kugabanyirizwa igihano itasuzumwa kuko yatanzwe impitagihe.
I. ISESENGURA RY’IBIBAZO BIRI MU RUBANZA
1) Kumenya niba impamvu Sibomana ataburanishije mu rubanza rujuririrwa yasuzumwa
nk’inenge iri muri urwo rubanza
[12] Sibomana Aimable n’umwunganira bavuga ko Urukiko rwamuhamije icyaha cyo gusambanya
umwana kandi ntacyo yakoze, kuko nta raporo ya muganga igaragaza ko uwo mwana yasambanyijwe ko
kandi byakozwe na Sibomana, ko ahubwo ari inzangano zishingiye ku mafaranga ye yishyuje nyirakuru
wa T.I, akaba yarashatse kumwihimuraho.
[13] Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga ko ubujurire bwa Sibomana Aimable nta shingiro bufite, kuko
ntacyo anenga imikirize y’urubanza rwajuririwe, bitewe n’uko ku rwego rwa mbere yemeye icyaha, no
mu bujurire bwa mbere akomeza kucyemera ndetse bishingiwaho agabanyirizwa igihano, ko rero kuba
yarajuriye bwa kabiri avuga ko yahamijwe icyaha atakoze ntacyo byamumarira kuko nta nenge agaragaza
iri mu rubanza yajuririye, bityo ko Urukiko rwakwemeza ko ubujurire bwe nta shingiro bufite.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[14] Impaka kuri iki kibazo zishingiye ku kumenya niba impamvu Sibomana ataburanishije mu rubanza
rujuririrwa yasuzumwa nk’inenge iri muri urwo rubanza.
[15] Nk’uko byasobanuwe mu rubanza RPAA00024/2021/CA rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa
29/07/2022 haburana Ubushinjacyaha na Mukayisenga, ibiburanwa mu rwego rw’ubujurire bigomba kuba
byari byaburanyweho mu rukiko rubanza. Impamvu itaraburanyweho mu rubanza rujuririrwa
ntiyasuzumwa ku rwego rw’ubujurire kuko itafatwa nk’inenge iri mu rubanza cyangwa ikosa ryakozwe
n’Urukiko rubanza ku buryo byashingirwaho biba impamvu y’ubujurire. Uyu murongo wakurikijwe mu
zindi manza, urwa nyuma rukaba ari urubanza RPAA00888/2024/CA rwaciwe ku wa 27/05/2025,
haburana Ubushinjacyaha na Uwamahoro Claire (igika cya 22).
[16] Ku birebana n’uru rubanza, bigaragara ko mu rubanza rujuririrwa, ikibazo cyonyine cyasuzumwe
ari ikirebana no kugabanyirizwa igihano bitewe n’uko aricyo Sibomana Aimable yari yajuririye,
abishingiye ku kuba icyo yahanishijwe kiremereye kandi yaremeye icyaha kuva mu nzego z’iperereza no
mu iburanisha ku rwego rwa mbere, Urukiko Rukuru rusanga kuba yaraburanye yemera icyaha kandi
akaba ari ubwa mbere akurikiranwe mu buryo buzwi byamubera impamvu nyoroshyacyaha, rubishiniraho

rumugabanyiriza igihano rumuhanisha igifungo cy’imyaka 21 mu mwanya w’igifungo cya burundu yari
yahanishijwe ku rwego rwa mbere.
[17] Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga impamvu y’uko Sibomana yahamijwe icyaha atakoze kuko nta
raporo ya muganga yagaragaje ko umwana yasambanyijwe ko kandi byakozwe na Sibomana, atarigeze
ayiburanisha mu Rukiko Rukuru, kuko nk’uko byibukijwe haruguru icyo yajuririye muri urwo Rukiko ari
nacyo cyasuzumwe ni ukugabanyirizwa igihano kuko yemeye icyaha, dore ko no ku rwego rwa mbere
yaburanye acyemera, ndetse uko kwemera icyaha akaba yarabivanyemo inyungu kuko byashingiweho
agabanyirizwa igihano.
[18] Urukiko rurasanga rero hashingiwe ku murongo watanzwe mu rubanza RPAA00024/2021/CA
rwavuzwe haruguru (mu gika cya 15), impamvu igamije guhakana icyaha Sibomana yemeye kuva ku
rwego rwa mbere no mu Rukiko Rukuru itaba inenge ku rubanza rujuririrwa, bityo ubujurire bwe kuri iyi
ngingo bukaba nta shingiro bufite.
2) Kumenya niba impamvu irebana no kugabanyirizwa igihano yasuzumwa
[19] Mu mwanzuro w’inyongera watanzwe n’uwunganira Sibomana Aimable, avuga ko mu gihe inkiko
zari zemeje ko ibyo yakoze bigize icyaha, zari kumugabanyiriza igihano kuko icyaha yakoze nta ngaruka
mbi zikomeye cyateje umwana wasambanyijwe, kandi akaba ari ubwa mbere akurikiranwe mu nkiko, ko
rero hashingirwa ku ngingo ya 49 n’iya 59 z’Itegeko Nº 68/2028 ryo ku wa 30/08/2028 riteganya ibyaha
n’ibihano muri rusange, n’ingingo ya 2 (a) y’Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko
rimaze kuvugwa, agahanishwa igifungo cy’imyaka 15.
[20] Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga ko impamvu irebana no kugabanyirizwa igihano itasuzumwa,
bitewe n’uko yatanzwe nyuma y’ibihe byo kujurira kuko itagaragara mu mwanzuro Sibomana yatanze
ajurira, kandi ko icyo kibazo cyatanzweho umurongo mu manza zaciwe harimo urubanza rwa Mbuto
Aimable na BRD.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[21] Impaka kuri iyi ngingo zishingiye ku kumenya niba impamvu y’ubujurire irebana no
kugabanyirizwa yatanzwe mu mwanzuro w’inyongera nyuma y’igihe cyo kujurira yakwakirwa.
[22] Ikibazo kirebana n’impamvu z’ubujurire zitanzwe mu myanzuro y’inyongera nyuma y’ibihe byo
kujurira byemewe n’amategeko, cyatanzweho umurongo n’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga mu rubanza
RCOMAA00071/2017/CS rwaciwe ku wa 26/10/2018 haburana Mbuto Aimable na BRD, Urwo Rukiko
rukaba rwarasobanuye ko ingingo iyo ariyo yose itanzwe nyuma y’ibihe ntarengwa byo kujurira, uretse
iyuzuza cyangwa isobanura iyatanzwe mu bihe byemewe byo kujurira, itagomba kwakirwa.
[23] Ku birebana n’uru rubanza, mu mwanzuro Sibomana Aimable yatanze ajurira, anenga ko
yahamijwe icyaha atakoze kuko nta raporo ya muganga yagaragaje ko umwana ashinjwa gusambanya
yasambanyijwe koko kandi bikozwe na we, akaba nta yindi mpamvu yatanze. Ahubwo mu mwanzuro
w’inyongera watanzwe na Me Shema T.Gerard nyuma y’igihe cyemewe cyo kujurira2, asaba ko Sibomana
yagabanyirizwa igihano.
[24] Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rushingiye ku murongo watanzwe mu rubanza rwavuzwe haruguru (mu gika
cya 22), rurasanga impamvu yo kugabanyirizwa igihano yatanzwe mu mwanzuro w’inyongera ibihe byo
kujurira byararenze itakwakirwa, kuko ituzuza cyangwa ngo isobanure iyatanzwe na Sibomana Aimable
mu gihe giteganywa n’amategeko.
2 Yatanze uwo mwanzuro ku wa 05/11/2025 kandi urubanza rujuririrwa rwaraciwe ku wa 13/01/2025.

[25] Hashingiwe ku byasobanuwe byose, Urukiko rurasanga kuba impamvu yo guhakana icyaha nta
shingiro yahawe naho iyo kugabanyirizwa igihano ikaba itakiriwe ngo isuzumwe, bivuze ko hagomba
kugumaho imikirize y’urubanza rwajuririwe, Sibomana agakomeza guhanishwa igifungo cy’imyaka 21
kubera icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana cyamuhamye.
III. ICYEMEZO CY’URUKIKO
[26] Rwemeje ko ubujurire bwa Sibomana Aimable nta shingiro bufite.
[27] Rwemeje ko hagumyeho imikirize y’urubanza RPA00324/2021/HC/NYZ rwaciwe n’Urukiko
Rukuru/Urugereko rwa Nyanza ku wa 13/01/2025.
[28] Rutegetse ko igifungo cy’imyaka makumyabiri n’umwe (21) Sibomana Aimable yahanishijwe ku
cyaha cyo gusambanya umwana kigumyeho.
